jobs.title: Program Manager - Research Operations
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews. 



Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.


The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.


Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. 



The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. 



We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.



Participant recruitment at Outset spans a global partner network, internal process, and the product experience itself — and this role owns all three. Rather than running recruitment study by study, you'll build the system that makes it predictable at scale. You'll be Outset's authority on recruitment: the connective tissue between our partners, our teams, and our product.

Responsibilities 

 - Own partner performance and communication, with a system to assess and continually optimize each partner's quality, reliability, and best-fit use cases.

 - Negotiate preferred rates and commercial terms, and build the feasibility process (incidence rates, targeting, which vendor for which use case) that keeps recruitment predictable as volume grows.

 - Design and document the end-to-end recruitment process, from intake through delivery — with fill-time benchmarks by audience/screening criteria and a clear playbook for tracking and escalating at-risk projects.

 - Build the internal enablement and training that gets the GTM team up to speed and confident in how recruitment works.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering on the recruitment experience — fraud detection, identity verification, quality flagging, refunds — bringing structured, evidence-backed problems into the product roadmap.

 - Identify and spec internal tooling that reduces manual ops work.

 - Translate how recruitment works into content for two audiences: best-practice guidance for Account Directors/AEs, and customer-facing explanations of our role, our partners' role, and what to expect.

Qualifications

 - 5–10 years in research operations, participant recruitment, or panel/vendor management, with deep expertise in digital qualitative recruitment; experience with quantitative recruitment is a plus

 - Hands-on understanding of how participant recruitment actually works: panels and marketplaces, screeners, incidence and feasibility, soft launches, quotas, incentives, fraud, and quality control.

 - Track record managing vendors and partners — selecting, negotiating, holding accountable, managing spend.

 - Genuine program management ability — you can hold a messy, cross-functional problem in your head, sequence it, and drive it to a working system.

 - Experience at both a large organization and a startup. We want the enterprise process instincts and the scrappiness to build fast without waiting for permission.

 - Strong communicator — able to distill complex, cross-functional information into clear training, documentation, playbooks, and customer-facing content.

 - Comfortable with AI tooling for content and automation; experience building AI tooling/dashboards a plus.

 - Highly independent — this role is built for someone who defines priorities as much as executes them.

 - Bonus: experience at a research platform, panel provider, or research agency.

jobs.title: Sales Director - Market Research & Insights
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews. 



Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.


The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.


Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. 



The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. 



We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.



We’re looking for a Sales Director, Market Research & Insights to help drive the next phase of growth at Outset.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP of Sales, responsible for selling Outset into Market Research and Insights teams across enterprise organizations.

You’ll own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and pipeline development through closing and expansion—working with both net new customers and expansion within existing accounts. This role requires a deep understanding of the Market Research ecosystem and the ability to build trusted relationships with research and insights leaders.

You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Customer teams to bring Outset’s AI-moderated research platform to leading research organizations, helping them dramatically accelerate how they generate insights about their customers and users.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the full sales cycle for Market Research and Insights teams, from prospecting to close.

 - Build and manage a pipeline of opportunities with both net new logos and existing customers.

 - Develop strong relationships with Market Research and Insights leaders at enterprise organizations.

 - Lead discovery conversations and product demonstrations that connect Outset’s capabilities to customer research workflows.

 - Drive complex enterprise sales processes involving multiple stakeholders and decision makers.

 - Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline visibility.

 - Partner with Marketing and outbound teams to develop targeted prospecting strategies into research organizations.

 - Collaborate closely with Customer Success and Research teams to ensure strong adoption and expansion opportunities post-sale.

 - Provide market feedback from research leaders to inform product development and go-to-market strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of exceeding quota.

 - 5+ years of experience in Market Research, or experience selling to Market Research or Insights teams.

 - Proven ability to run full-cycle enterprise sales, including prospecting, managing complex deal cycles, and closing new business.

 - Deep understanding of the Market Research ecosystem and how research teams operate.

 - Exceptional communication, executive presence, and relationship-building skills.

 - Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced startup environment.

 - Strong problem-solving and consultative selling skills.

 - Willingness to travel for customer meetings and industry events as needed.

jobs.title: Scaled Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews. 



Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.


The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.


Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. 



The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. 



We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.



As a Scaled Customer Success Manager, you'll own adoption, retention, and growth across a mature portfolio of 100–200+ accounts in our Scaled segment — and you'll build the systems that make covering a book that size possible.

You'll determine the right signals, automate analysis and follow-ups, and design an operating model that gives customers an excellent experience. Roughly 70% of your time will be portfolio management; the other 30% will be building the infrastructure and process behind it — working closely with RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering.

This is a foundational hire. The health scoring, playbooks, and operating cadences you build will be the ones the team runs on for years, and you'll help define what "Scaled" means at Outset as the segment grows.

Responsibilities

 - Own adoption, retention, and expansion outcomes across a portfolio of 100–200+ Scaled accounts, from onboarding through renewal

 - Keep usage and adoption high in a deliberately lower-touch model — leverage programs, automation, and self-service before reaching for a calendar invite

 - Monitor account health and usage signals to catch risk and expansion opportunities early, and prioritize where your direct time actually changes the outcome

 - Run renewals across a mixed model of actively managed and auto-renewing accounts, partnering with our broader CS team on commercial approach

 - Build and run one-to-many programs: onboarding cohorts, office hours, webinars, in-product guidance, documentation, and templated success plans

 - Develop our account health tracking methodology from the ground up — what signals matter, how they're weighted, how they trigger action, and how we know the scoring is predictive

 - Partner cross-functionally with RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering to build the infrastructure behind scaled CS: usage instrumentation, alerting, lifecycle triggers, and automated follow-up

 - Design the operational cadence for this segment: what regular communication looks like, how issues route to and from Product Support, and what escalation looks like. (Product Support owns ticket resolution. You own the process around it).

 - Build reporting in Hex and with other AI tools that gives the business real visibility into Scaled segment health, adoption, and retention

 - Translate portfolio-wide patterns into prioritized input for Product

Qualifications

 - 3–7 years in customer success, account management, CS operations, sales, or lifecycle/growth, including a high-volume portfolio

 - Experience building scaled or digital CS programs from scratch, or working as one of the first hires in a scaled CS role

 - Technically fluent and self-sufficient with data: product analytics and usage, pulling data with AI tools, and building tooling with AI

 - Hands-on with a modern GTM and support stack. Ours is Pylon, Hex, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Claude; we lean heavily on AI day to day and expect you to as well

 - Excellent written and verbal communication

 - Series A/B/C or fast-paced SaaS experience, with a proactive, ownership-driven approach to ambiguity

Nice to have

 - Experience defining or re-segmenting a customer base, or standing up a support model for a new segment

 - Background in customer marketing, growth, or RevOps

 - Familiarity with research operations or market research
